    w=len(b1[0]); h=len(b1)
    best=None
    for s in range(-w+1,w):
        ok=sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if 0<=c+s<w and b1[r][c]==b2[r][c+s])
        n=sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if 0<=c+s<w)
        if best is None or ok/n>best[1]: best=(s,ok/n)
    return best
